programs.title: Thomas & Friends: All Engines Go!
programs.desc: When the engines are delivering attractions to the annual Harwick Beach Carnival, a series of mistakes causes the precious Calliope to break. Luckily, the engines come up with a creative solution.

programs.title: Play School: Down At The Beach
programs.desc: Alex and Emma are joined by special guest wildlife scientist Dr. Vanessa who shows us her special diving equipment! Humpty and Little Ted discover sea turtle eggs in the sand and collect rubbish from the beach.

programs.title: Fireman Sam
programs.desc: At a picnic on Annie's farm, Peter comes up with a series of games that almost lead to disaster! Meanwhile, Lizzie and Jodie search for a rare seal.

programs.title: Miffy and Friends
programs.desc: Miffy is invited over at Ko's for their first playdate. They're excited to play together but have trouble finding something they both like to do - and can do at the same time.

programs.title: The Woohoos!
programs.desc: Iggy thinks his caterpillar friend has disappeared. The Woohoos work out that caterpillars turn into butterflies.

programs.title: Nikhil & Jay
programs.sub_title: Nikhil and Jay and the Supervillain
programs.desc: After a power cut ruins family movie time, Nikhil and Jay pretend to be superheroes to find the supervillain who took the power!

programs.title: Daniel Tiger's Neighbourhood
programs.desc: When Daniel is feeling a little nervous for his first trip to the hospital, Mum and Dad Tiger prepare him for his new experience. After he arrives, Daniel meets a doctor and nurse who put him at ease and help him get better.

programs.title: Mittens & Pants
programs.desc: It's Dogaversary! Pants wants to celebrate being friends with Mittens (like she did with him for Cataversary), but he's just not sneaky enough to surprise Mittens.

programs.title: BeddyByes
programs.desc: MeMo helps BaBa to see a caterpillar. BaBa helps themself to build a tower. MeMo and BaBa help the Yummies, and Fungi and Pungi help MeMo and BaBa on the Lullaby Lake.

programs.title: Mixmups
programs.desc: The Mixmups go on an Upside Down Adventure but, when the Lucky Loover Bird gets stuck on the ceiling, they need to find another way to get her down.

programs.title: Ready Eddie Go!
programs.desc: Eddie writes and posts a letter to Grandad. With Dad's help, he draws pictures, writes about his week, and carefully posts it in the letterbox.

programs.title: Bluey
programs.desc: Bluey and Bingo want everyone to play Charades, but Muffin and Socks are too young to understand the rules and Nanna must think quickly to keep the game on track.
